cleavage_agent: digested in-gel with trypsin (PROMEGA), and further identified by MS.
instrument: The cleared peptide digests were analyzed using a Q-Exactive HF Hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Hemel Hempstead, UK)
ionization_type: The MS analyses were performed using a quadrupole model mass spectrometer (MicrQ-TOF III; Bruker Daltonics) with an electrospray ionization source
labeling: Proteomics was based on two-dimensional gel electrophoresis (2-DE) along with mass spectrometry identification, and shotgun proteomics with label-free quantification.
mass_analyzer: inferred: Q-Exactive HF Hybrid quadrupole-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
ptm: methionine oxidation as a variable modification, carbamidomethylation of cysteine as a fixed modification
